attacks.name: Reckless Charge

attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), this Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.

bw7-107.flavorText: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

This Pokémon is now that Pokémon. (Any cards attached to this Pokémon, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.)

bw7-108.flavorText: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

attacks.name: Double Lariat
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

bw7-109.flavorText: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

attacks.name: Attract Smack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

bw7-110.flavorText: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

bw7-111.flavorText: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

bw7-112.flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

bw7-113.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

attacks.name: Gather Energy

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

bw7-114.flavorText: The reason it does not have a nest is that it simply searches for a clean, comfortable place then sleeps there.

attacks.name: Whimsy Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

bw7-115.flavorText: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

bw7-116.flavorText: By extending its rolled up ears and striking the ground, it can bound so high it surprises itself.

attacks.name: Healing Melody
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, heal 60 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Kick Away
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

bw7-117.flavorText: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

attacks.name: Patrol
attacks.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back on top of your deck in any order.

bw7-118.flavorText: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Psych Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Psych Up attack does 30 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

bw7-119.flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

bw7-120.flavorText: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it's also smart enough to check its foe's strength and avoid battle.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

bw7-121.flavorText: This very loyal Pokémon helps trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Sentinel
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from his or her hand.

bw7-122.flavorText: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.

attacks.name: Razor Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

bw7-123.flavorText: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

bw7-124.flavorText: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.

attacks.name: Wing Flick
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

bw7-125.flavorText: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.

attacks.name: Hip Bump
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

abilities.name: Busybody
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is in your hand, you may reveal it. If you do, heal 10 damage and remove a Special Condition from your Active Pokémon. Then, discard this Pokémon.

bw7-126.flavorText: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
